title: Achtung! Scam! Alle Daten weg

author: a.caterina

title: Old premium doesn't work
body: I bought the app and now I should pay for the subscription model?

title: Let’s report the devs to app story staff!
body:
I paid for the unlimited and lifelong version BEFORE they changed it to a subscription model. This is completely fine as a business to do. What is not okay is that they decided to DELETE the existing premium user accounts, and having their former premium users pay again to have the premium features. This is highly illegal, and does not comply with App Store guidelines.

Please REPORT them to the App Store staff! This is the only way that we can make the developers aware of this! I believe they know it, and try to scam us premium users. This is the reason why we should report them!

author: stianmescudi

title: Basic functions not in place
body: It is really annoying that I cannot allocate a specific habit to a specific day in the week. You‘d expect such a basic function to be in place. Otherwise the design and usability is fine.
author: CFlow84

title: Cool, but...
body:
Great habit tracker. It‘s really helpful to me!

I’m missing 2 things though:

1) It would be great if I could switch the calculation of the percentages to a formula where the quote of the last 30 days are taken into account, like, for example of a daily behavior: in the last 30 days from now I was 23 days successful and 7 days not = 77%.

2) a universal App for iPad support with iCloud sync would be great!
author: Son of a switch
